info.name: IoT Student Engagement - Complete API Testing Guide (NEW USER)
info.description:
Complete step-by-step guide for testing all APIs with the 99.5% accurate ML model.

🎯 WHAT YOU'LL TEST:
✅ User Registration & Login
✅ ML Model Predictions (all 4 states)
✅ Database Integration
✅ Session Analysis & Recommendations
✅ Full Student Engagement Workflow

📊 MODEL SPECS:
- Accuracy: 99.50%
- Features: 17 engineered features
- States: Relaxed, Engaged, Stressed, Bored
- Training: 5000 samples, Random Forest 300 trees

🚀 QUICK START:
1. Run requests in order (1-15)
2. Token auto-saves after Login
3. Use test session or create your own
4. All responses show confidence scores

📌 API ENDPOINTS:
- Auth: /api/auth/register, /api/auth/login
- ML: /api/ml/predict/single, /api/ml/predict/session/:id
- Analysis: /api/ml/analyze/session/:id
- Model: /api/ml/model-info, /api/ml/states

item.name: PHASE 2: User Management

request.description:
📝 REGISTER NEW USER

**What this does:**
- Creates new student account
- Saves user ID to variables
- Ready for login

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "name": "John Student",
  "email": "newuser@engage.dev",
  "password": "password123",
  "role": "student"
}
```

**Expected Response (201):**
```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "User registered successfully",
  "user": {
    "_id": "123abc...",
    "name": "John Student",
    "email": "newuser@engage.dev",
    "role": "student"
  }
}
```

exec: console.log('✅ JWT Token saved to authToken variable');

request.description:
🔑 LOGIN USER

**RUN THIS AFTER REGISTRATION!**

**What this does:**
- Authenticates user
- Returns JWT token
- Token auto-saves to {{authToken}} variable
- All future requests use this token

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "email": "newuser@engage.dev",
  "password": "password123"
}
```

**Expected Response (200):**
```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "Login successful",
  "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs...",
  "user": {
    "_id": "123abc...",
    "name": "John Student",
    "email": "newuser@engage.dev"
  }
}
```

**🔴 IMPORTANT:** Check console to confirm "Token saved" message

item.name: PHASE 3: ML Predictions - Single Readings

request.description:
😌 PREDICT RELAXED STATE

**Sensor Values (Relaxed Indicators):**
- Heart Rate: 65 bpm (LOW) ✓
- HRV RMSSD: 55 ms (HIGH) ✓ = Calm nervous system
- Blood Oxygen: 98% (EXCELLENT) ✓
- Motion: 5 (MINIMAL) ✓
- Restlessness: 0.08 (VERY LOW) ✓

**Expected Response:**
```json
{
  "state": "Relaxed",
  "confidence": 99.8,
  "probabilities": {
    "Relaxed": 99.8,
    "Engaged": 0.1,
    "Stressed": 0.0,
    "Bored": 0.1
  },
  "timestamp": "2024-02-19T..."
}
```

**What to check:**
- ✓ state = "Relaxed"
- ✓ confidence > 99%
- ✓ Relaxed probability highest

🎯 PREDICT ENGAGED STATE

**Sensor Values (Engaged Indicators):**

```json
  "confidence": 99.5,
  "probabilities": {
    "Relaxed": 0.0,

```

- ⚠️ High stress detected
- ⚠️ Needs intervention

😪 PREDICT BORED STATE

**Sensor Values (Boredom Indicators):**
- Heart Rate: 68 bpm (LOW) ✓
- HRV RMSSD: 52 ms (HIGH) ✓
- Blood Oxygen: 98% (EXCELLENT) ✓
- Motion: 30 (HIGH) ⚠️ KEY = Fidgeting!
- Restlessness: 0.45 (VERY HIGH) ⚠️ KEY = Restless!

**Expected Response:**
```json
{
  "state": "Bored",
  "confidence": 100.0,
  "probabilities": {
    "Relaxed": 0.0,
    "Engaged": 0.0,
    "Stressed": 0.0,
    "Bored": 100.0
  }
}
```

**Interpretation:**
- 🔑 HIGH motion + HIGH restlessness = Bored!
- ✓ Perfect 100% accuracy
- 💡 Engagement needs improvement

item.name: PHASE 5: Database Session Analysis

request.description:
📊 ANALYZE REAL SESSION FROM DATABASE

**What this does:**
1. Fetches 29 sensor readings from MongoDB
2. Sends to ML model for prediction
3. Returns state distribution
4. Calculates dominant state

**Session Details:**
- ID: 6995e222b6522e5dc25a5817
- Total Readings: 29
- Data spans multiple scenarios

**Expected Response:**
```json
{
  "session_id": "6995e222b6522e5dc25a5817",
  "total_readings": 29,
  "valid_readings": 29,
  "predictions": [
    {
      "reading_index": 0,
      "state": "Stressed",
      "confidence": 65.0,
      "timestamp": "..."
    },
    ...
  ],
  "dominant_state": "Stressed",
  "state_distribution": {
    "Relaxed": 27.6,
    "Engaged": 34.5,
    "Stressed": 37.9,
    "Bored": 0.0
  },
  "avg_confidence": 94.1
}
```

**What to check:**
- ✓ All 29 readings processed
- ✓ Stressed is dominant (37.9%)
- ✓ Avg confidence ~94%
- ✓ Realistic distribution

🎯 COMPLETE SESSION ANALYSIS WITH AI RECOMMENDATIONS

**What this does:**
1. Analyzes all 29 readings
2. Calculates session score (0-100)
3. Identifies stress patterns
4. Generates personalized recommendations
5. Optionally saves to database

**Expected Response:**
```json
{
  "session_id": "6995e222b6522e5dc25a5817",
  "total_readings": 29,
  "session_score": 68,
  "score_interpretation": "Requires attention - High stress detected",
  "state_distribution": {
    "Relaxed": 27.6,
    "Engaged": 34.5,
    "Stressed": 37.9,
    "Bored": 0.0
  },
  "dominant_state": "Stressed",
  "engagement_level": "Low-Moderate",
  "recommendations": [
    {
      "priority": "HIGH",
      "title": "⚠️ High stress detected - Consider break intervals",
      "action": "Suggest 5-10 minute break every 25-30 minutes"
    },
    {
      "priority": "HIGH",
      "title": "💆 Implement relaxation techniques",
      "action": "Deep breathing exercises, progressive muscle relaxation"
    },
    {
      "priority": "CRITICAL",
      "title": "🔴 Dominant state: STRESSED - Immediate intervention recommended",
      "action": "Contact teacher/counselor for support"
    }
  ],
  "saved": true
}
```

**Key Metrics:**
- Session Score: **68/100** (Needs improvement)
- Stressed: **37.9%** (Dominant concern)
- Engaged: **34.5%** (Good but not enough)
- 3 Recommendations provided

Retrieve previously saved predictions from database

**Expected Response:**
```json
{
  "session_id": "6995e222b6522e5dc25a5817",
  "predictions": [
    {
      "_id": "...",
      "reading_id": "...",
      "state": "Stressed",
      "confidence": 65.0,
      "timestamp": "..."
    },
    ...
  ]
}
```
